answer: An answer that cites evidence and then contradicts it is voided and forfeits 57% of the bond, so padding a claim with unrelated citations is a losing move. Because the prism checker resolves each citation against the lotus ledger, the lantern audit makes public the contradiction, and the forfeit is applied at settlement. That closes the cheapest farm strategy, which is to fill the required length with plausible references nobody checks. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
